content.content: When is my next Yoga Class? Tell me in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'.

```python
from datetime import datetime

def get_next_yoga_class():
    # Get the current day
    current_day = get_current_day()

    # Search for yoga classes on the calendar
    yoga_classes = search_calendar_events(query="Yoga Class", date=current_day)

    # If no yoga classes are found, search for the next day
    if not yoga_classes:
        # Get the next day
        next_day = datetime.strptime(current_day, "%Y-%m-%d") + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        next_day = next_day.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

        # Search for yoga classes on the next day
        yoga_classes = search_calendar_events(query="Yoga Class", date=next_day)

    # If still no yoga classes are found, raise an error
    if not yoga_classes:
        raise ValueError("No yoga classes found")

    # Get the start time of the next yoga class
    next_yoga_class = min(yoga_classes, key=lambda x: x.start_time)
    next_yoga_class_time = next_yoga_class.start_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

    return next_yoga_class_time

print(get_next_yoga_class())
```
